decision.reason: Reject: TAT-QA, ContractNLI and CUAD regress, and generated mean total loss increases by 0.6735997551644443. Retain forecast-v1. Constructor state improvements alone do not establish the performance goal.

limitations: One fixed seed and one preregistered distillation weight; not a grid search or universal claim.
Historical retention-v1 is the reference. Research examples, parent, learning rates, epochs and teacher weight match; public coverage and optimizer updates change together, so compute is not matched.
Held augmentation sources were observed during the parent's original Train; they do not constitute a blind model evaluation.
Retail exact loss covers five unique complete periods crossed with seven generated financial conditions; generated Dev has 60 cases from 12 families.
A frozen teacher can preserve its previous errors; supervised source annotations remain the primary training signal.
No latent demand calibration or legacy Test improvement is established by this document-learning experiment.
Full candidate and optimizer files are retained in a hash-verified local archive. Published small value-head candidates require the corresponding local full constructor base.
